title: Elemental blobs
changes: Four new lands in the far east (Lv 14 to 25): Blightmire Fen, Rimewater Hollow, Cinder Scar and Stormbreak Crags.
New blobs: the Venom Blob spits poison puddles, the Frost Blob casts a frost nova, the Fire Blob breathes fire, and the Storm Blob leaves electric sparks when hit.
New damage type Electric: sparks leap to a nearby foe. Look for Crackling weapons and Grounded armour.
The blob quest line goes on with Morwen, Rowan and Brann: shatter the four Heart Shards and face the Fourfold Gloam.
